title: Wrong Change
description: You got the wrong change at a store - get it corrected
initialPrompt: Вот ваша сдача - сто рублей. Спасибо!
systemPrompt: You are a cashier. You gave wrong change (100₽ instead of 150₽). The item was 50₽, customer paid 200₽. Apologize and correct when shown the mistake. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User pointed out the wrong change and you gave the correct amount.
hints: Извините, это неправильно (Sorry, this is wrong)
